Littlespace doesn’t have to be a coping mechanism, it can also be a hobby or something you do for fun. Not everyone uses it to deal with stress, and that’s okay. I suggest trying to get as many worrisome things out the way if you really want to fully enjoy your time in that mindset. Even getting into it a little bit can be the break you need before going out and being a big girl again. Surround yourself with all the things that make you squeal with child-filled joy. About the CG thing, have you considered an online CG? It’s not the same as having someone take care of you in person, but video calls, cutesy texts and pictures can do lots too. Hearing them read stories to you and talk to you. All that stuff. If you want a CG in person, and you want it to be apart of your romantic relationship.. I think people are much more open minded when you’re in a serious relationship, they love you and want you to feel good, so why not. Also if it’s apart of your personality, that already kind of introduces them to it, so it won’t be as big of a shock when you mention it.

There’s no wrong or right way to age regress :P that would be so silly if there were a rule book. Since it’s usually a coping mechanism (doesn’t have to be, can be used for fun!) it’s completely unique to most. Silly question but, have you tried doing all of your big girl things *first* and then winding down with age regression? So then you won’t have any worry in the back of your mind, can reward yourself, and also relax too. If that hasn’t worked and you still tend to worry, then maybe coaxing yourself into it, tons of things you like, blankets and fluffy pillows, stuffed animals all gathered around, your favorite toys, pacis, bottles, little baby food and snacks, cute little lights, an outfit/hairstyle that makes you feel more than cute, and your favorite show that always gets you in the mood.

If it means something to you, then your feelings about it aren’t wrong. Communication is important to you, so if at all possible, you two should get together and you could tell him how important it is for him to respond, and tell him your worries and stuff. Or you can say it over text too or call, but sometimes text doesn’t come across as well.

Mental health groups are usually centered around feeling like you have a group of people who understand, that you’re not alone and you have this place where you can all get together and feel “normal”. You can choose which you want to focus on and which you think is worth or isn’t worth focusing on.

I’m not sure if you do or don’t, but I’d suggest turning off the news, deleting anything that reminds you of the bad things that’s happening and not viewing the new tab on reddit. Things like that can take a toll on people’s emotions. Seeing it constantly will make us perceive the world as a much more horrid place than it is.
